external_authority.source: Jansen and Scheffler, Generalized coloring for tree-like graphs
external_authority.statement: List Coloring on partial k-trees is linear-time when the number of colors is bounded by a constant.

external_authority.source: Bodlaender, A Linear-Time Algorithm for Finding Tree-Decompositions of Small Treewidth
external_authority.statement: For fixed k, treewidth<=k can be recognized and a width-k tree decomposition constructed in linear time.

external_authority.source: Arnborg, Proskurowski, Corneil, Forbidden minors characterization of partial 3-trees
external_authority.statement: Treewidth<=3 / partial 3-trees are characterized by four minimal forbidden minors: K5, octahedron, Wagner graph V8, pentagonal prism.

recognition.algorithm: Run fixed-k treewidth recognition for k=3.

list_coloring.input: Exact lists L(v) subseteq [4] and a width-3 decomposition.
DP: Keep exactly the proper, list-respecting bag assignments that extend to the processed subgraph.
Introduce transition: add a color for one introduced vertex and enforce list membership and bag-edge properness.
Join transition: combine child tables agreeing on the common bag.
Accept iff a root state survives and reconstruct via stored witnesses.
list_coloring.complexity: Linear in graph/decomposition size up to a constant depending only on treewidth 3 and palette size 4.

forbidden_minor_characterization.equivalence: tw(C)<=3 iff C excludes all four minors K5, OCTAHEDRON, WAGNER_V8, PENTAGONAL_PRISM.
forbidden_minor_characterization.negative_certificate: For one selected obstruction H, give one nonempty connected branch set B_v for each v in V(H), pairwise disjoint, and for every uv in E(H) an original graph edge between B_u and B_v.
